_doc: Per-row judgement of the A0 prediction against reality, not against the gold string. FORMAT_ONLY/ALIAS = factually correct, sub-EM failed on presentation. Adjudicated by reading the prediction against known fact + gathered web evidence.

In what year was the tallest lighthouse.why: 1990 = Jeddah Light (133m), widely cited as the world's tallest lighthouse. 1902 = Ile Vierge, tallest *traditional/stone* one. The question does not state the qualifier, so the prediction is defensible.

The most populous city in Punjab is how.why: 1,772 km2 = Lahore (Punjab, Pakistan); 310 km2 = Ludhiana (Punjab, India). The question does not disambiguate the two Punjabs.

In 2016, who was the host of the longest.why: Pat Sajak hosts Wheel of Fortune, the longest-running *syndicated* game show. The Price Is Right is the longest-running American game show; Drew Carey hosted it in 2016.

When did Nirvana's second most selling s.why: 24 Sep 1991 is Nevermind, the BEST-selling album. The second is In Utero (1993) — the ordinal hop failed.
